mapper.select: SELECT popup_id, title, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, bg_color, width, height, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM popup WHERE is_active = 1 AND (started_at IS NULL OR started_at <= NOW()) AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= NOW())
SELECT popup_id, title, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, bg_color, width, height, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_at FROM popup

SELECT popup_id, title, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, bg_color, width, height, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM popup WHERE popup_id = #{popupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO popup(title, subtitle, image_key, link_url, link_target, link_label, bg_color, width, height, is_active, started_at, ended_at, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{subtitle}, #{imageKey}, #{linkUrl}, #{linkTarget}, #{linkLabel}, #{bgColor}, #{width}, #{height}, #{isActive}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE popup SET is_active = #{isActive} WHERE popup_id = #{popupId}
